_comment: FIX 2026-09-17 13:55: go-live policy. The bot stays in paper mode until ALL conditions are met simultaneously. FIX 2026-09-18 19:35: thresholds raised to industry-standard quant-fund paper-to-live criteria. Edit this file to override defaults.

rationale.min_consecutive_green_days: 10 trading days = ~2 calendar weeks of consistent profitability. Most quant shops require 2+ weeks of paper consistency before deploying capital.
rationale.min_cumulative_return_pct: 15% return is the standard threshold for demonstrating edge vs luck. CFA 'Performance Evaluation' uses 15% as a benchmark for skill vs luck in active management; common quant firm hurdle rate.
rationale.min_avg_daily_pnl_rs: Rs.1,000/day on Rs.100k base = 1%/day. Above noise floor and transaction costs; considered real alpha threshold.
rationale.min_total_trades: 30 trades minimum for statistical sample size. Below 30 trades, win rate and Sharpe estimates have wide confidence intervals and aren't reliable for go-live decisions.
